y-m-58-05.topic: Iziseko zokubala nethuba: ukuthelekisa iimodeli ezimbini

y-m-58-08.title: Xa kukho i-vertex kodwa ingeyiyo eyona incinci
y-m-58-08.topic: Iziseko zokusebenzisa imisebenzi yesibini: eyona incinci kuluhlu olunqunyelweyo
y-m-58-08.goal: Yazi ukuba xa idomeyini inqunyelwe, eyona incinci yomsebenzi inokugqitywa esiphelweni sexesha endaweni ye-vertex, ufumane ulungise impazamo, uze ufumane amaxesha ahambelana nemeko wena.
y-m-58-08.material: Cinga ngomsebenzi f(x)=(x−2)². Igrafu yawo ine-vertex yayo kwi-(2, 0) kwaye ivulekele ngaphezulu (nokude x ukusuka ku-2, f(x) iyakhula). Xa idomeyini inqunyelwe hayi kuwo onke amanani okwenyani kodwa kwixesha elivaliweyo [a, b], sifumana eyona inkulu neyona incinci ye-f.
y-m-58-08.prereq.0: Ingcinga yokuba uyayazi igrafu yomsebenzi wesibini y=(x−p)² (i-vertex, ukuhambelana, ukuvuleka ngaphezulu)
y-m-58-08.s.s1.prompt: Esi sisisombululo xa idomeyini yi-3 ≤ x ≤ 5. Khetha umgca ophosakeleyo.
y-m-58-08.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola ukuba i-x-coordinate ye-vertex 2 ingaphakathi kwexesha 3 ≤ x ≤ 5.
y-m-58-08.s.s1.line.0: Igrafu ye-f(x)=(x−2)² yipharabola evulekele ngaphezulu ene-vertex kwi-(2, 0).
y-m-58-08.s.s1.line.2: Y-coordinate ye-vertex yi-0, ngoko eyona incinci kuloo xesha yi-0 nayo.
y-m-58-08.s.s1.explain: Umgca 3 yimpazamo. Ikhowudinethi ye-x yencopho, 2, ayiphakathi kwexesha 3 ≤ x ≤ 5. Ngoko eyona incinci yi-f(3)=1, kwi-x=3, ichaphaza lexesha elisondele kakhulu ku-2.
y-m-58-08.s.s2.prompt: Khetha onke amaxesha apho eyona incinci ka-f ingu-0 xa indawo ligama exesha.
y-m-58-08.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ufumane ixabiso lika-x apho f(x)=0.
y-m-58-08.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuba ixesha ngalinye liquka eli xabiso lika-x na.
y-m-58-08.s.s2.r.a: Usenokuba ujonge kuphela ububanzi bexesha okanye inxalenye yamaxabiso ungahlolanga ukuba incopho iphakathi kwexesha na.
y-m-58-08.s.s2.r.b: Oku kukhetho olwaziyo ukuba iziphelo zexesha nazo zibandakanyiwe kwindawo.
y-m-58-08.s.s2.r.c: Usenokuba ucinge ukuba eyona incinci ngu-0 nangona incopho ingaphandle kwexesha.
y-m-58-08.s.s2.r.d: Oku kukhetho olwahlola imeko apho incopho iphakathi kwexesha.
y-m-58-08.s.s2.r.e: Oku kukhetho olwaziyo ukuba incopho ibandakanyiwe nokuba isesiphelweni sexesha.
y-m-58-08.s.s2.explain: Ukuze eyona incinci ibe ngu-0, x=2, apho f(x)=0, kufuneka abe sexesheni. 0 ≤ x ≤ 2, 1 ≤ x ≤ 4 kunye no-2 ≤ x ≤ 2.5 ziquka u-2, ngelixa −2 ≤ x ≤ 1 no-3 ≤ x ≤ 6 azikwenzi oko.
y-m-58-08.s.s3.prompt: Khetha amanani aphelele a, b (a<b) ukumisela ixesha [a, b] uze ufumane uze ungenise onke amaxesha apho eyona incinci ka-f kuloo xesha ingu-1 kwaye eyona inkulu ingu-9. (Amaxesha ama-2 ahlukeneyo)
y-m-58-08.s.s3.hint.0: Fumana u-x onobuninzi be-9 ukusuka ku-(x−2)²=9 uze uzame ukumbeka kwisiphelo esinye sexesha.
y-m-58-08.s.s3.hint.1: Hlola ukuba eyona incinci iba yintoni ukuba elo xesha liquka u-x=2.
y-m-58-08.s.s3.fail.c1: U-a no-b kufuneka babe ngamanani aphelele ane-a<b.
y-m-58-08.s.s3.fail.c3: Eyona incinci kuloo xesha ayingu-1. Ukuba incopho x=2 iphakathi kwexesha, eyona incinci ngu-0.
y-m-58-08.s.s3.explain: Eyona inkulu u-9 yenzeka apho x ikwi-3 ukusuka ku-2 (−1 okanye 5), kwaye eyona incinci u-1 yenzeka apho x ikwi-1 ukusuka ku-2 (1 okanye 3). Ukuba ixesha liquka incopho 2, eyona incinci iba ngu-0, ngoko amaxesha amabini kuphela [3, 5] kunye [−1, 1] anokwenzeka.

y-m-58-01.title: Ukuze udibaniso lube 'ngumsebenzi'
y-m-58-01.topic: Intsingiselo yomsebenzi: iimeko zokuba udibaniso ube ngumsebenzi
y-m-58-01.goal: Sebenzisa iimeko ezimbini 'ilungu ngalinye lomhlaba lidityaniswa (akukho elishiyiweyo), kanye kanye' kunye noluhlu lwe-codomain kwizidibaniso zokwenyani ukuze ugwebe, uze wakhe ibinzana elanelisa iimeko ngokwakho.
y-m-58-01.material: Eklasini, umsebenzi wachazwa ngolu hlobo: 'Xa ilungu ngalinye x leseti X lidityaniswa nelungu elinye kanye leseti Y, olu dibaniso lubizwa ngokuba ngumsebenzi ukusuka ku-X ukuya ku-Y.' Namhlanje X yi-{1, 2, 3, 4} yaye Y yi-{0, 1, 2, 3}. Zikho izidibaniso ezine (가) ukuya ku-(라).
y-m-58-01.thinking.0: Vavanya imeko enye ngexesha kudibaniso ngalunye

Apha, ingqiqo ye-'Basic Mathematics 2' yesikolo samabanga aphezulu icingelwa njengenqanaba emva kokufunda iintsingiselo ezisisiseko zemisebenzi, jiyometri nedatha kwimathematika yesikolo samabanga aphakathi.
y-m-58-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izidibaniso ezingemisebenzi ukusuka ku-X ukuya ku-Y. (Izidibaniso: 가) intsalela xa x yahlulwa nge-3 나) x−1 다) amanani akwi-Y angaphantsi kwe-x 라) x−2)

y-m-58-01.s.s1.r.a: Usenokuba ukhethe ngokujonga igama ledibaniso kuphela ngaphandle kokuhlola ukuba ixabiso linqunywe njengelinye ('kanye kanye').
y-m-58-01.s.s1.o.b: (가) Dibanisa x nentsalela xa x yahlulwa nge-3
y-m-58-01.s.s1.r.b: Oku kukhetha okwenziwe ngokufaka x njenge-1, 2, 3, 4 enye ngexesha nokujonga ukuba ixabiso linye yaye likwi-Y.
y-m-58-01.s.s1.r.c: Usenokuba ujonge kuphela ukuba x nganye inexabiso elinye, ungajongi ukuba eli xabiso likwi-Y.
y-m-58-01.s.s1.r.d: Oku kukhetha okwenziwe ngokufumana amaxabiso kuyo yonke i-x nokuthelekisa ne-Y.
y-m-58-01.s.s1.explain: (가) yi-1→1, 2→2, 3→0, 4→1 kwaye (나) yi-1→0, 2→1, 3→2, 4→3, ngoko zonke zinexabiso elinye yaye zikwi-Y. Kwi-(다), xa x=2 amaxabiso amabini, u-0 no-1, adityaniswa, ngoko 'kanye kanye' liyaphuka, yaye kwi-(라), xa x=1, i-−1 ingaphandle kwe-Y.
y-m-58-01.s.s2.prompt: UJihu wathi (다) ngumsebenzi. Khetha umgca ongalunganga kwingxoxo kaJihu.
y-m-58-01.s.s2.hint.0: Phawula kumgca ngamnye ukuba yeyiphi 'kwiimeko ezimbini zenkcazelo' esijonga isivakalisi.
y-m-58-01.s.s2.hint.1: Kumgca ngamnye, jonga ngokwahlukeneyo ukuba zingaphi iixabiso ezihambelana ne-x nokuba ezo xabiso zingaphakathi kwi-Y na.

y-m-58-01.s.s2.line.2: Ukuba x=2, amanani akwi-Y angaphantsi kwe-2 ngu-0 no-1, amabini.

y-m-58-01.s.s3.prompt: Ngoku wandisa i-codomain ibe yi-Y'={0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8}. Yenza umsebenzi f(x)=px+q (p no-q ngamanani aphelele) ukusuka ku-X={1, 2, 3, 4} ukuya ku-Y' ukuze ii-x ezahlukeneyo zidityaniswe namaxabiso ahlukeneyo (p ayingu-0), uze ufumane ufake (p, q) ezi-3 ezahlukeneyo.

y-m-58-01.s.s3.explain: Umzekelo, f(x)=x inika i-1 ukuya kwi-4, f(x)=2x−1 inika i-1, 3, 5, 7, kwaye f(x)=−x+5 inika i-4, 3, 2, 1. Intetho yomgca itshintsha kuphela kwicala elinye xa x ikhula, ngoko ukuba amaxabiso kuphela kwi-x=1 nakwi-x=4 angaphakathi kwe-Y', zonke ii-x eziphakathi zingaphakathi nazo.

y-m-58-07.title: Idatha efanayo, igrafu enempembelelo eyahlukileyo
y-m-58-07.topic: Ukubonisa idatha: idatha efanayo, iigrafu ezahlukeneyo
y-m-58-07.goal: Qonda ukuba ixabiso lokuqala nolwahlulo lwe-axis ethe nkqo yenza idatha efanayo ibonakale ngokwahlukileyo, ufumane ulungise inkcazelo egqithisiweyo, uze ukhethe wena isikali esihambelana nemeko.
y-m-58-07.material: Intengiso yenyanga yevenkile (izinto) yi-200 ngoJanuwari, i-204 ngoFebruwari, i-208 ngoMatshi ne-212 ngoEpreli (idatha eyenziwe ngokucinga). Inqaku lephephandaba A lapapasha igrafu yomgca ene-axis ethe nkqo ezotywe ukusuka kwi-0 ukuya kwi-250, kwaye inqaku B lapapasha igrafu yomgca ene-axis ethe nkqo ezotywe ukusuka kwi-198 ukuya kwi-214. Amanqaku kuzo zombini iigrafu yidatha efanayo. Umgca kwigrafu B ubonakala unyuka ngokuthe nkqo.
y-m-58-07.prereq.0: Ukufunda igrafu yomgca (inqanaba lesikolo samabanga aphakathi)
y-m-58-07.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke iingxelo eziyinyaniso malunga neegrafu ezimbini.
y-m-58-07.s.s1.hint.0: Funda ixabiso lenqaku likaJanuwari nexabiso lenqaku likaEpreli kwenye yeegrafu ezimbini uthelekise.
y-m-58-07.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba inyaniso yokuba uluhlu lwee-axis ezime nkqo luyahluka luchaphazela njani imo yethambeka lomgca.
y-m-58-07.s.s1.o.a: Igrafu B ibonakala ithe nkqo ngakumbi, ngoko intengiso yokwenyani ikhule ngokukhawuleza kwi-B
y-m-58-07.s.s1.o.b: Ukutshintsha ukuqala nesithuba sesikali se-axis ethe nkqo kunokunika impembelelo eyahlukileyo nakwidatha efanayo
y-m-58-07.s.s1.r.b: Uyazi ukuba indlela idatha eboniswa ngayo inokutshintsha impembelelo, nakwidatha efanayo.
y-m-58-07.s.s1.o.c: Igrafu B, ene-axis ethe nkqo engaqali kwi-0, yigrafu yobuxoki ezoba amaxabiso edatha ngokwahlukileyo
y-m-58-07.s.s1.r.c: Amanqaku e-B abonisa amaxabiso afanayo nedatha yokwenyani nawo. Ingxaki ayingamaxabiso kodwa yimpembelelo eyenziwe sisikali.
y-m-58-07.s.s1.o.d: Intengiso eboniswa ngamanqaku kuzo zombini iigrafu iyalingana
y-m-58-07.s.s1.r.d: Olu lukhetho luqinisekisa ukuba idatha efanayo yazotywa ngezikali ezahlukeneyo.
y-m-58-07.s.s1.explain: Iigrafu ezimbini zizoba nje idatha efanayo nge-axis ethe nkqo eyahlukileyo. Ukutshintsha i-axis kunokwenza umgca ubonakale uthe nkqo ngakumbi, kodwa intengiso ngokwayo iyafana. I-axis eqala kwi-0 ayiyo eyona intle ngalo lonke ixesha nayo (umzekelo, kwidatha apho utshintsho oluncinci kufuneka lubonakaliswe).
y-m-58-07.s.s2.prompt: Khetha umgca ophosakeleyo kwinkcazelo yomhlaziyi B yenqaku.
y-m-58-07.s.s2.hint.0: Funda ukuba lelixabiso elithini elihambelana nokuphakama 0 kwigrafu B.
y-m-58-07.s.s2.hint.1: Fumana wena umlinganiselo wentengiso kaJanuwari nokaEpreli.
y-m-58-07.s.s2.line.0: Intengiso inyuke ngezinto ezi-4 inyanga nganye: 200, 204, 208, 212.
y-m-58-07.s.s2.line.1: Ukusuka kuJanuwari ukuya kuEpreli inyuke nge-12, ngoko inyuke nge-6 pesenti yexabiso lokuqala.
y-m-58-07.s.s2.line.2: Kwigrafu B, inqaku likaEpreli liphezulu ngamaxesha ama-7 kunenqaku likaJanuwari, ngoko intengiso yaba maxesha ama-7.
y-m-58-07.s.s2.line.3: Ngoko kunokubhalwa ukuba lo mzi-venkile ukhula ngokukhawuleza kakhulu.
y-m-58-07.s.s2.explain: Umgca 3 yimpazamo. I-axis ethe nkqo yegrafu B iqala kwi-198, ngoko ukuphakama kwenqaku kubonisa kuphela umahluko ukusuka kwi-198 (2 no-14). Intengiso ngokwayo inyuke ukusuka kwi-200 ukuya kwi-212, eyi-6 pesenti hayi amaxesha ama-7. Umgca 4 sisigqibo esixhomekeke kuloo mpazamo.
y-m-58-07.s.s3.prompt: Ngoku ufuna ukuzoba igrafu yenqaku C ngokunyanisekileyo. Gqiba isiphelo esisezantsi y0 nesiphelo esiphezulu y1 se-axis ethe nkqo (zombini ziyimiphindaphindo ye-10, y0 i-200 ubuninzi, y1 i-212 ubuncinane) ukuze ukunyuka kwe-12 ukusuka kuJanuwari ukuya kuEpreli kubonakale kuyi-10% okanye ngaphantsi kobude bonke be-axis ethe nkqo. Ukuze isikali singabi banzi kakhulu, y1−y0 i-400 ubuninzi. Faka (y0, y1) ezi-2 ezahlukeneyo.
y-m-58-07.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ngenkcazelo ukuba ukunyuka kwe-12 yipesenti ephi yobude bonke be-axis ethe nkqo.
y-m-58-07.s.s3.hint.1: Cinga ukuba i-axis kufuneka ibe ndee kangakanani ubuncinane ukuze lo mlinganiselo ube yi-10% okanye ngaphantsi.
y-m-58-07.s.s3.ok.c2: Idatha 200 ukuya kwi-212 ihambelana ngaphakathi kwe-axis.
y-m-58-07.s.s3.fail.c2: Idatha 200 ukuya kwi-212 kufuneka yonke ihambelane ngaphakathi kwe-axis.
y-m-58-07.s.s3.ok.c3: Ukunyuka kwe-12 kuyi-10% okanye ngaphantsi kobude be-axis.
y-m-58-07.s.s3.fail.c3: Ubude be-axis bufutshane, ngoko i-12 ibonakala inkulu kune-10%.
y-m-58-07.s.s3.explain: Ukuba ubude be-axis bu-120 okanye ngaphezulu, i-12 ibonakala iyi-10% okanye ngaphantsi. Imizekelo: 0 ukuya kwi-250 (ubude 250) kunye ne-100 ukuya kwi-300 (ubude 200) zombini ziyenzeka. I-axis ayifuni ukuqala kwi-0; ubude bufuna nje ukwanela.
